verdicts.reason: A has the reading order scrambled: BEST OFFERS and the URL sit between TV DEALS and BLACK FRIDAY, so the kicker now comes after its headline. The colourful brand graphics are cut down to a tiny confetti cluster and a stray speck, which leaves a large dead grey middle, and the date box sits on its own at the bottom. B keeps BLACK FRIDAY above TV DEALS, but the paint-stroke art is crammed into a clipped diagonal strip and a stray white rule floats in the empty middle. The pink box holds only the date, with BEST OFFERS spilled out below it, and the URL is jammed against the bottom edge. Both are broken; B is marginally less bad because the headline order survives.
